CommunityApplications.Profile:
Emby Insights is a personal, mobile-first media dashboard for Emby users. It complements the Emby player instead of replacing it: personal playback statistics, recently watched content, recommendations, upcoming movies/shows, and (optional) media requests via Seerr — all in the user's own login, backed by their normal Emby account.
This repository hosts the single Docker template for the all-in-one Emby Insights container (backend + PostgreSQL + Redis in one image). Support and bug reports via GitHub Issues on the main repository.
